Project Alpha Design Document

Project Alpha is a distributed task scheduler built on NATS JetStream.
The system uses a three-tier architecture: Tier 1 stores task definitions in
RustFS, Tier 2 maintains lineage in PostgreSQL, and Tier 3 provides vector
search for task similarity.

The embedding model used is jina-embeddings-v5-text-small-mlx with 1024
dimensions. Chunks are 2000 characters with 200-character overlap.

Key design decisions:
- HNSW index with m=16, ef_construction=64 for the embedding column
- BM25 index using simple text configuration for bilingual support
- Reciprocal rank fusion with k=60 combining dense and lexical legs
- Reranking window of 24 candidates with pool floor reservations
- Context budget of 120000 UTF-8 bytes per query response

The system processes approximately 1000 tasks per hour during peak load.
Latency requirements are under 500ms for dense search and under 200ms for
lexical search at the 95th percentile.
